verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents two first-party scripting interfaces. Its AppleScript support can launch the app and open sessions with profiles in new tabs or windows, and an AutoLaunch script runs at startup. Its Python package and API offer 'full automation and customization', and a community user independently corroborates writing a working Python script to control iTerm2. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of sending text to sessions and querying session/window state, and a dedicated command-line binary (control is via AppleScript/Python rather than a documented CLI).
